name: repair_request
description: One repair request message this validator sent to a peer, reported once when it settles: its answer arrived, its metadata reply was checked, the deadline passed (PENDING_TTL, about 1 s after req_time), or it was evicted. Each message asks for one thing: a window_index or window_index_for_block_id pick sends one message per missing shred of the FEC set, so one row each, sharing peer, req_time, attempt and pick; the other kinds are one message per pick. A hedge or retry to another peer is another pick. Messages never sent have no row; see the rotor tile's Timeout* and SigningHalted metrics, and TimeoutOverdueNanos for sign slot starvation. Emitted by the rotor tile.

peer_identity.description: Validator identity of the peer asked.

peer_ip.description: IPv4 address the request was sent to, stored as an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address.

peer_port.description: UDP port the request was sent to: the peer's serve-repair port in gossip when sent.

peer_rank.description: The peer's stake rank in the current epoch when the message settled, 0 for the most staked, as ranked by the repair strategy (65535 if unstaked or no longer known).

window_index.description: Shreds of one FEC set, by slot and index.

highest_window_index.description: The highest shred a peer holds of a slot, to learn the block's length.

orphan.description: The ancestry of a slot whose parent block is not held.

parent_and_fec_set_count.description: Alpenglow: a block's parent and FEC set count, with a proof against its block id.

fec_set_root.description: Alpenglow: the merkle root of one FEC set, with a proof against its block id.

window_index_for_block_id.description: Alpenglow: shreds of one FEC set of a specific block.

slot.description: Slot of the block asked about.

block_id.description: Block id of the block asked about; all zeros for turbine's block until it completes.

shred_idx.description: For window_index and window_index_for_block_id, the index of the shred the message asked for. For fec_set_root, index of the first shred of the FEC set asked about. For highest_window_index, the shred index sent: the first index past the highest FEC set received; the peer answers only if it holds a shred at or past it, or the slot is complete. 0 for orphan and parent_and_fec_set_count.

req_time.description: When the message was queued for signing; it leaves once its signature returns, so res_time - req_time includes sign latency.

res_time.description: When this message's answer was received off the network (by the shred tile for shreds, the net tile for metadata replies); for bad, when the reply that failed its proof arrived; 0 if none.

answered.description: Its shred arrived, or its metadata reply passed its proof. A highest_window_index or orphan reply that does not complete the slot carries a nonce the shred tile cannot verify, and is dropped unmatched if its shred or FEC set is already held.

expired.description: The deadline (about 1 s after req_time) passed with no answer. Counts toward banning the peer only if no message of the same pick was answered, see ban.

unanswerable.description: The deadline passed with no answer to a highest_window_index or orphan message, or to a message for a slot at or below the root, including one rooted while in flight; never bans.

bad.description: A metadata reply from the peer's address failed its proof; the peer is banned for 10 s.

evicted.description: Dropped unsettled because the pending request table was full; ours, not the peer's; never bans.

superseded.description: A highest_window_index or orphan message with no answer whose answer arrived another way before the deadline: the block's length, or its parent's ancestry, became known; a reply may have been a shred already held, dropped unmatched; never bans.

ban.description: Whether and why settling this message's pick banned the peer for 10 s. A pick settles once at the deadline, so every message of a pick left unanswered then carries the same ban.

by_id.description: Its 4th window_index_for_block_id pick in a row expired with no by-id answer.

streak.description: Its 32nd pick in a row expired with no answer of any kind.

bad_proof.description: Its metadata reply failed its proof.

attempt.description: Earlier picks for the same request before this one, 0 for the first; at most 255.

first.description: First attempt: the fastest available peer, an unmeasured one every 16th pick.

hedge.description: A later attempt, after the last peer's hedge time, preferring any peer but the last one asked.

staked_hedge.description: A later attempt for a block not known only from turbine, from staked peers only.

escape.description: A later attempt after 3 in a row brought no new shred of the FEC set: a random peer among the top 100 stake ranks, higher ranks likelier.

role.description: Role of the block asked about in its slot when sent.

eager.description: Neither the slot's notarized nor finalized block: turbine's block, or another block of the slot known by id.

notar.description: The slot's first notarized, or stronger, block.
